title: Kodera2023: Left/right-hand motor-imagery EEG dataset
description: A left/right-hand motor-imagery EEG dataset recorded at the University of West Bohemia from 29 healthy participants performing cue-based single-class imagery of left or right hand movement. Recordings were acquired with BrainVision hardware in four runs per session and annotated with HED tags. This BIDS re-release was produced via MOABB from the original Zenodo deposit, for brain-computer interface research.
methods_description: Participants performed cue-based left- or right-hand motor imagery with visual cues, with each recording containing a single class and a 4 s trial interval. EEG was recorded with BrainVision Recorder (BrainProducts) at 500 Hz from 9 channels (Fz, Cz, Pz, F3, F4, P3, P4, C3, C4) in the standard 10-20 montage, with 50 Hz line frequency. Each session had 4 runs.
